headline: Monitor Coastline Stability and Seasonal Trail Access
reservation: While specific entry permits are not cited, visitors must heed on-site warning signs regarding unstable cliffs and landslips. Check official National Trust status for Langdon Hill and Stonebarrow Hill car parks prior to arrival as secondary slips can occur without warning. Vehicle access and parking availability vary by site.

days.title: The Heights of Golden Cap

stops.name: Golden Cap
stops.detail: Ascend the highest point on the South West coast for views spanning Lyme Bay to Dartmoor on clear days. Explore the circular woodland walks around Langdon Hill or review the seven trail leaflets available at Stonebarrow Hill.

days.driving: Allow 20-40 minutes for local coastal roads; conditions vary.
days.note: Stay well back from cliff edges due to natural instability and potential landslips.

intel.title: Estate Access Points
intel.text: Use Langdon Hill car park for the direct ascent or Stonebarrow Hill for alternative trail starts. Both locations provide designated disabled parking spaces and level surfaces for wheelchair access.

intel.title: Cliff Safety
intel.text: The Jurassic Coast cliffs are naturally unstable and liable to falls at any time. Avoid visiting active landslips and observe all closures posted on footpaths or in car parks.

intel.title: Wildlife Windows
intel.text: Spring and summer are ideal for spotting rare orchids and dragonflies within the estate. Woodland highlights in the Scots pine and larch sections are available year-round.

intel.title: Local Services
intel.text: Evidence does not specify fuel or charging locations within the estate boundaries. Verify station locations in nearby gateway towns before committing to coastal driving.

intel.title: Connectivity Gap
intel.text: Mobile signal strength is not documented in official sources for this specific ridge. Download trail leaflets or offline maps prior to arriving at Langdon Hill.

plan.arrival: Pick up a rental in regional hubs; head to Langdon Hill car park to begin the ascent or Stonebarrow Hill for trail leaflets.
plan.vehicle: Standard vehicles are suitable for established car parks; check for any local height or width restrictions on narrow Dorset lanes.
plan.goldenHour: Golden Cap summit offers 360-degree views ideal for sunset, though cliff stability must be monitored if staying late.
